case.task_context:
## 1. Project Scaffold

- [ ] 1.1 Create `TouchVault/Package.swift` with `swift-argument-parser >= 1.3.0` dependency and executable target named `tvault`
- [ ] 1.2 Create SPM directory structure: `Sources/tvault/`, `Commands/`, `Core/`, `Utils/`
- [ ] 1.3 Add `main.swift` with `@main` struct routing to sub-commands via `swift-argument-parser`
- [ ] 1.4 Verify `swift build` succeeds with empty stubs for all sub-commands

## 2. Core: Keychain Access Layer

- [ ] 2.1 Create `Core/KeychainStore.swift` — define `Constants.keychainService = "TouchVault-vault"`
- [ ] 2.2 Implement `KeychainStore.save(key:secret:)` using `SecItemAdd` with `kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly`
- [ ] 2.3 Implement `KeychainStore.update(key:secret:)` using `SecItemUpdate` for `errSecDuplicateItem` path
- [ ] 2.4 Implement `KeychainStore.fetch(key:context:)` passing `kSecUseAuthenticationContext` for shared LAContext reuse
- [ ] 2.5 Implement `KeychainStore.delete(key:)` using `SecItemDelete`
- [ ] 2.6 Implement `KeychainStore.listKeys(prefix:)` using `kSecReturnAttributes: true`, `kSecMatchLimitAll` — no Touch ID, no secret data

## 3. Core: Touch ID Authentication

- [ ] 3.1 Create `Core/AuthService.swift` with `AuthService.authenticateOnce(reason:)` that calls `evaluatePolicy(.deviceOwnerAuthenticationWithBiometrics)` via `DispatchSemaphore`
- [ ] 3.2 Handle `.userCancel` LAError → output `error: Touch ID authorization cancelled.` and exit 1
- [ ] 3.3 Handle `canEvaluatePolicy` returning false → output biometric unavailable error and exit 1
- [ ] 3.4 Implement `AuthService.authenticateWithPassword(reason:)` using `.deviceOwnerAuthentication` policy for `--password` fallback
- [ ] 3.5 Expose the authenticated `LAContext` instance from `authenticateOnce` for downstream Keychain calls

## 4. Utils: Terminal I/O

- [ ] 4.1 Create `Utils/Terminal.swift` with `readSecretInput(prompt:)` that disables `ECHO` via `termios`, reads a line, then restores echo
- [ ] 4.2 Implement `Terminal.printWarning(_:)` — outputs yellow `⚠  warning: …` to stderr
- [ ] 4.3 Implement `Terminal.printError(_:)` — outputs red `✖  error: …` to stderr
- [ ] 4.4 Implement `Terminal.printSuccess(_:)` — outputs `✓ …` to stdout

## 5. Commands: `tvault set`

- [ ] 5.1 Create `Commands/SetCommand.swift` with `@Argument` for key path and `@Flag(-f/--force)`
- [ ] 5.2 Wire `readSecretInput` for blind password capture
- [ ] 5.3 Call `KeychainStore.save` — on `errSecDuplicateItem` prompt user for overwrite confirmation (unless `--force`)
- [ ] 5.4 Handle `--force` by calling `KeychainStore.update` directly, skipping confirmation
- [ ] 5.5 Output `✓ Saved.` or `✓ Updated.` on success; exit 1 on failure

## 6. Commands: `tvault get`

- [ ] 6.1 Create `Commands/GetCommand.swift` with `@Argument(completion: .custom { ... })` for key path and `@Flag(--password)`
- [ ] 6.2 Wire `AuthService.authenticateOnce` (or `authenticateWithPassword` if `--password`)
- [ ] 6.3 Call `KeychainStore.fetch(key:context:)` and print secret to stdout
- [ ] 6.4 Handle all error cases: key not found, auth failed, user cancel — correct messages and exit 1

## 7. Commands: `tvault list`

- [ ] 7.1 Create `Commands/ListCommand.swift` with optional `@Argument` prefix and `@Flag(--tree)`
- [ ] 7.2 Call `KeychainStore.listKeys(prefix:)` — no Touch ID
- [ ] 7.3 Implement flat output: sort keys lexicographically, print one per line
- [ ] 7.4 Implement tree output: parse `/` separators and render ASCII tree with `├──`, `│`, `└──`

## 8. Commands: `tvault delete`

- [ ] 8.1 Create `Commands/DeleteCommand.swift` with `@Argument` for key path
- [ ] 8.2 Wire `AuthService.authenticateOnce` then `KeychainStore.delete`
- [ ] 8.3 Handle key not found with error message and exit 1; output `✓ Deleted.` on success

## 9. Core: .env Parser

- [ ] 9.1 Create `Core/EnvParser.swift` with `EnvParser.parse(fileURL:)` returning `(plain: [String:String], vaultRefs: [String:String])`
- [ ] 9.2 Handle `KEY=vault://<path>` lines — extract path into vault refs map
- [ ] 9.3 Handle `KEY=value` lines — extract into plain vars map
- [ ] 9.4 Strip inline comments (`# …`) and skip blank/comment-only lines
- [ ] 9.5 Implement multi-file merge: load files in order, later values override earlier

## 10. Core: Environment Merger

- [ ] 10.1 Create `Core/EnvMerger.swift` implementing three-tier priority merge:
  - Tier 1 (highest): host system `ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment`
  - Tier 2: vault-resolved secrets
  - Tier 3 (lowest): plain `.env` values
- [ ] 10.2 Ensure system variables are never overwritten by vault or plain values
- [ ] 10.3 Unit-test the merge logic with all three priority scenarios

## 11. Commands: `tvault run`

- [ ] 11.1 Create `Commands/RunCommand.swift` with `@Option(name: .customLong("env"))` array, `@Flag(--strict)`, and `@Argument` remainder for command + args
- [ ] 11.2 Implement default env file discovery: probe `[".env", ".env.development", ".env.local"]` when no `--env` given
- [ ] 11.3 Parse all env files via `EnvParser`, collect vault refs and plain vars
- [ ] 11.4 Call `AuthService.authenticateOnce` (single Touch ID for all vault refs)
- [ ] 11.5 Resolve all vault refs via `KeychainStore.fetch(key:context:)` using shared LAContext
- [ ] 11.6 Handle missing vault refs: warn (default) or abort with exit 1 (`--strict`)
- [ ] 11.7 Call `EnvMerger.merge` to produce final env dict
- [ ] 11.8 Launch child process via `Foundation.Process` with merged environment and passthrough I/O
- [ ] 11.9 Forward SIGINT to child process and exit 130 on receipt
- [ ] 11.10 Propagate child process exit code as `tvault run` exit code

## 12. Shell Completion

- [ ] 12.1 Create `Utils/Completion.swift` with `vaultKeyCompletions(_:)` function querying `KeychainStore.listKeys()` silently
- [ ] 12.2 Wire `@Argument(completion: .custom { vaultKeyCompletions($0) })` in `SetCommand` and `GetCommand`
- [ ] 12.3 Verify `tvault --generate-completion-script zsh` and `--generate-completion-script fish` produce valid output
- [ ] 12.4 Test that completion callback produces no Touch ID prompt and handles empty vault silently

## 13. Error Handling & Exit Codes

- [ ] 13.1 Audit all commands to ensure `exit 0` on success, `exit 1` on runtime errors, `exit 2` reserved for ArgumentParser parse errors
- [ ] 13.2 Verify `exit 130` is emitted on SIGINT in `run` command
- [ ] 13.3 Confirm no stack traces or debug output leak to stderr on user-facing errors

## 14. Build & Integration

- [ ] 14.1 Run `swift build -c release` and confirm clean build with zero warnings
- [ ] 14.2 Install binary to `/usr/local/bin/tvault` and manually test `set`, `get`, `list`, `run` with a real Touch ID prompt
- [ ] 14.3 Register zsh completion and verify Tab expansion lists vault keys
- [ ] 14.4 Test `--strict` mode with a missing vault key confirms abort behavior
- [ ] 14.5 Test multi-file env priority: system env beats vault beats plain `.env`
